Resolves #22115

The full Engine E2E tier now runs on 18 shards instead of 15. On this head the balanced planner put each of 15 shards at 324–362 s against the 360 s run-step ceiling; at 18 the planned maximum is 301 s. `FULL_SHARDS.engine` and `test.yml`'s full-matrix defaults move together, and the testing guide and the classifier comment follow.

Evidence: L2 (allocator replay and the selection unit spec run locally; this PR's hosted full matrix runs in CI) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2; AC-3 is this PR's own CI). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #21033.

CI jobs: +3 — a full run's Engine tier needs three more shards: the measured total (5,341 s) no longer fits 15 shards under the 360 s step, and timing refreshes cannot add slack the total leaves none of (#22073, #22077, #22101).

Change class: restoration (`fix`). agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit baseline guards ran.

## Test Evidence

Allocator replay at `2dd3117f17` (base `f80d68a3d4`) through the workflow's own path: `--paths` → `TIER_PATHS` → `--engine-paths` with `SHARD=i/18`. All 327 Engine specs are assigned exactly once (0 duplicates, 0 missing), and the planned load is 264–301 s per shard. The same head at `SHARD=i/15` plans 324–362 s.
